Two call sites bypass the whole-number display entirely — a template-literal interpolation in javascripts/core/celestials/celestials.js and two bare bindings in src/components/tabs/celestial-pelle/PelleTab.vue. This is the original upstream bug, and it is the only layer an agent reaches by pattern-matching \"number rendered raw\".\n23\t\n24\t2.
